scope: All 60 failed/unverified sources from the baseline260-entry public audit.
semantics: Static policy excludes retired sources from scanning, operational lists and installation. Existing records/history remain. Unverified jobs expire after 14 days since last verification, after scan finalization; independently verified source aliases keep a job active. Public diagnostic alone does not persist jobs or start expiry.
caveats: All 19 recovered snapshots are partial and bounded; no claim of complete employer catalogs.
Final repeat returned 992 rows versus 993 earlier: one additional Ministry vacancy could not be verified in that run. This is not proof that the vacancy closed.
Counts are before track classification, personal filters, duplicate reconciliation and ranking; not newly inserted production jobs.
Retired sources may have vacancies; failure to verify collection is not proof of absence.
The existing shared 64 MiB/day catalog transfer guard can defer work. Production current Supabase usage has not been rechecked.
